```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The government and private sector must work together to address the cyberthreats posed to the United States, help the free flow of information between network managers, and encourage innovation and investment in cybersecurity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The government must improve its protection of its own systems, which contain sensitive data and control important facilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An update of the law drafted a decade ago should be done to improve the security of government information systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Investment in continuing research is needed to develop cutting-edge cybersecurity technologies to protect the U.S.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sharing cyberthreat information between the government and industry is the most effective way of combating potential cybersecurity threats.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The free flow of information within the private sector should be protected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's laws and policies undermine a collaborative relationship and put both the government and private entities at a disadvantage in proactively identifying potential cyberthreats.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's costly and heavy-handed regulatory approach will increase the size and cost of the federal bureaucracy and harm innovation in cybersecurity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government collects valuable information about potential threats that can and should be shared with private entities without compromising national security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Companies should be free from legal and regulatory barriers that prevent or deter them from voluntarily sharing cyberthreat information with their government partners.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
